rows.prediction:
From the rear of the flock we fly,
Amidst the birds that soar high.
Their wings spread wide, their feathers a sight,
As they soar through the sky with all their might.

The world below us is a blur of green and brown,
A patchwork of fields and trees that sway and swoon.
We follow our kin, our feathered kin,
In this dance of flight that's both free and serene.

The wind carries our calls, our songs we sing,
A chorus of wings that echoes and clings.
We are a part of this flock, this family,
In this moment of flight, we are one and free.

As we fly, we see the world from above,
A beautiful chaos that's full of love.
We are the last to land, the first to rise,
In this flock, we find our place and our prize.

So we fly on, our wings spread wide,
A part of this flock, a part of this ride.
Together we soar, together we glide,
In this dance of flight, we are one and tied.
